get_skills_root_path: get the root path of the skills directory for the deer-flow project
load_skills: load all skills from the skills directory including public and custom categories
load_skills_enabled_only: load only enabled skills from the skills directory using extensions config
load_skills_custom_path: load skills from a custom path instead of the default skills directory
load_skills_no_config: load skills without reading from config, using the default skills root path
